# Masabur Rahman Sifat

> Creative Engineer & UI/UX Designer specializing in high-density frontend architecture, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and bespoke dark-mode web systems.

## Summary
Masabur Rahman Sifat builds high-contrast, production-grade web applications and digital agency sites. Focus areas include custom UI design systems, anti-slop frontend standards, and smooth hardware-accelerated interfaces.

## Primary Skills & Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Design & UI**: UI/UX Design Systems, Glassmorphic Accents, Industrial & Obsidian Themes, WCAG Accessibility
- **Tooling & Platforms**: VS Code, Git, Vercel, Netlify, Node.js

## Featured Projects
- [Nebula Digital Agency](https://sifatrahman.com/projects/nebula): Web platform with dynamic theme toggling, Formspree lead capture, interactive ROI calculator, and performance optimizations.
- [Chorma Agency Site](https://sifatrahman.com/projects/chorma): Dark-mode interactive web showcase with custom loading overlays, orbital motion design, and magnetic cursor physics.
- [Sparkle Clean](https://sifatrahman.com/projects/sparkle-clean-chandpur): Zero-dependency local cleaning service platform optimized for Chandpur, Bangladesh with direct WhatsApp booking.
- [MoveMate Moving Planner](https://sifatrahman.com/projects/movemate-moving-planner): Interactive moving planner web app with checklist, cost estimator, timeline, and zero framework bloat.
- [ContentForge](https://sifatrahman.com/projects/contentforge): Experimental AI content creation workspace for social media creators with hook, caption, and script generators.
